race.comment: CANNY MISS (12) bolted in fresh up when winning fresh up at Balaklava, and then tried hard when up in class at Murray Bridge 3 weeks ago, finishing fourth after hitting the front early in the run home. She maps to receive a cosy run here, and should be hard to hold out. ANAHORISH (13) needed the run, and did nothing here 2 weeks ago when 6 weeks between runs. She is better than that, and with only a fortnight since that effort, she will be a lot sharper. Stick with her at some each-way value. PAGANINI (5) has been freshened up since a modest run 8 weeks ago, and a recent trial would have kept his fitness up to the mark. Some sting out of the ground will suit him, and he is worth including in all combos. KALMANA (3) peaked on his run late fresh up here a fortnight ago, and even from another wide gate, she can improve sharply.
